description: Controllers watch pressures, flows, and alarms and operate the 3 RCVs and the receipt flow control valve through the hosted SCADA service; the Operations Manager at the gas control desk in business hours, the on-call controller by laptop after hours
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public safety (an undetected rupture or overpressure must be seen and acted on); firm supply to a municipal gas system serving about 9,000 homes and businesses; mechanical regulators hold delivery pressure without SCADA, but 4 field-qualified staff can man the receipt station and the municipal gate station for only about one 8-hour shift before fatigue forces a pressure reduction or curtailment
manual_workaround: Manual operation: technicians at the receipt station and the municipal gate station read local gauges and report by phone every 30 minutes; RCVs operated by hand at the site; mechanical regulators and overpressure protection keep delivery pressure within limits; a clean spare laptop with a phone hotspot restores the SCADA view if only the office is affected
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05 (controller laptops); SYS-06
dependent_third_parties: Hosted SCADA vendor; cellular carrier; internet provider; upstream interstate pipeline gas control
dependent_people_or_facilities: Operations Manager; 2 Pipeline Technicians; Corrosion and Measurement Technician; office and gas control desk; receipt station and municipal gate station

business_process: Emergency response and public safety communication
description: Receive and classify emergency notices; call 9-1-1 centers, the fire department, and the county emergency manager; make the NRC telephonic notice when an incident occurs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 49 CFR 191.5 requires notice no later than one hour after confirmed discovery of an incident; 192.615(a)(8) requires immediate notice to the 9-1-1 center after a notification of potential rupture; nothing in this process may wait for IT recovery
manual_workaround: Personal cell phones; printed emergency contact list in the truck binders, at the office, and at the Owner's and Operations Manager's homes
dependent_systems: None required (phones only); SYS-07 holds the electronic contact list

description: Confirm daily nominations with the upstream interstate pipeline and the customers' gas suppliers; track imbalances; confirm scheduled volumes with the 3 customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Nominations run on the gas day; a missed cycle creates imbalances and puts next-day deliveries to the municipal system at risk
manual_workaround: Phone and email confirmations with the interstate pipeline's scheduling desk; spreadsheet of the last 7 days kept on the Gas Scheduler's laptop and printed weekly
dependent_third_parties: Upstream interstate pipeline (portal and scheduling desk); customers' gas suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Gas Scheduler; Operations Manager as backup

business_process: Gas measurement and customer volume reporting
description: Collect hourly and daily volumes from the 4 flow computers through SCADA; validate meters; send monthly volume statements to customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Flow computers keep about 35 days of hourly data locally, so volumes can be recovered later; statements are monthly
manual_workaround: Download flow computer archives on site with the technician's laptop; estimate from upstream interstate pipeline data
dependent_third_parties: Hosted SCADA vendor; upstream interstate pipeline
dependent_people_or_facilities: Corrosion and Measurement Technician; field sites

business_process: Field O&M, corrosion control, and compliance records
description: Keep the O&M manual, emergency plan, control room management records, operator qualification records, maps, patrol and leak survey records, and cathodic protection readings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FPSC inspections and 192.631(j) require records for review; maps and procedures are needed for field work within days
manual_workaround: Printed O&M manual and emergency plan in each truck and at the office; paper field forms entered later

description: Monthly transportation invoices from volume statements; payables; bank transfers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices are monthly; the company holds a cash reserve of about 60 days of expenses
manual_workaround: Invoice from the prior month's volumes and true up later

description: Biweekly payroll through an outside payroll service; HR files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; HR files hold employee personal information (Fla. Stat. 501.171 if exposed)
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll

description: The SCADA vendor's anomaly module scores pressure and flow data and sends advisory alerts to the on-call phone
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Trial only; controllers do not rely on it, and SCADA alarms and field methods remain primary (P10)
